Hottest Actresses From The 80s: What They Look Like Now!

13 March 2024 · RewindZone Archive

So we've already touched on The Hottest 90s Female Stars, let's now turn our attention to the 1980s. A decade that celebrated beauty, glamour, and iconic fashion trends. During this era, a constellation of actresses graced the silver screen, captivating audiences with their undeniable allure and talent. From the sultry bombshells to the fresh-faced ingenues, these women left an eye-catching mark on popular culture, forever etching their names in the annals of Hollywood history. In this article, we embark on a nostalgic journey, exploring the top 20 hottest actresses from the 1980s, revisiting their magnetic charm and enduring appeal. Prepare to be transported back in time, reliving the moments when these stunning beauties ruled the silver screen.

  • Michelle Pfeiffer

Birth Year: 1958

With her smokey eyes, high cheekbones, and killer pout, Michelle Pfeiffer exuded a sultry yet refined sexuality in 1980s films like "Scarface," "The Fabulous Baker Boys," and "Dangerous Liaisons." Her ability to ooze sensuality while maintaining an air of mystique made her irresistible to audiences.

Michelle Pfeiffer has made a successful comeback after a 10-year hiatus and has been actively pursuing challenging roles in recent years

2. Christie Brinkley

Birth Year: 1954

Christie Brinkley's all-American beauty and stunning physique were on full display in her 1980s appearances, including "National Lampoon's Vacation." Her sun-kissed locks, piercing blue eyes, and toned figure cemented her status as a true sex symbol.

Christie Brinkley, known for her modelling career, has continued to be active in the entertainment industry and has been involved in various projects over the past decade.

3. Kathy Ireland

Advertisement

Birth Year: 1963

Kathy Ireland's exotic features and enviable curves set pulses racing in 1980s films like "Alien From L.A." and "Loaded Weapon 1." Whether posing for Sports Illustrated or on the big screen, she exuded a confident sexuality that was both empowering and alluring.

Kathy Ireland, a former supermodel turned entrepreneur, has expanded her business empire and continued to be a prominent figure in the fashion and lifestyle industries.

4. Cheryl Ladd

Birth Year: 1951

With her golden locks, radiant smile, and girl-next-door charm, Cheryl Ladd embodied the quintessential California beauty in the hit 1980s TV series "Charlie's Angels." Her effortless allure made her a beloved icon of the decade.

Cheryl Ladd has remained active in acting and has appeared in various TV shows and films over the past decade.

5. Farrah Fawcett

Birth Year: 1947

Farrah Fawcett's feathered blonde tresses and sparkling smile became the epitome of 1970s and 1980s sex appeal, particularly in her iconic role in "Charlie's Angels." Her poster adorned the walls of countless teenage boys' bedrooms.

Farrah Fawcett continues to be remembered for her contributions to television and film, even after her passing in 2009.

6. Jaclyn Smith

Birth Year: 1945

With her regal beauty, poise, and timeless elegance, Jaclyn Smith brought a sophisticated allure to the small screen as Kelly Garrett in "Charlie's Angels" during the 1980s. Her effortless grace and style embodied classic Hollywood glamour.

Jaclyn Smith has been involved in various projects and has maintained her presence in the entertainment industry.

7. Lea Thompson

Advertisement

Birth Year: 1961

Lea Thompson's fresh-faced beauty and infectious charm made her a beloved ingenue in classic 1980s films like "Back to the Future" and "Some Kind of Wonderful." Her natural charisma and girl-next-door appeal captivated audiences.

Lea Thompson has continues to act in films and TV shows, showcasing her talent and versatility as an actress.

8. Phoebe Cates

Birth Year: 1963

Phoebe Cates' exotic looks and effortless cool factor made her a true bombshell in the 1980s cult classic "Fast Times at Ridgemont High." Her iconic pool scene became a pop culture phenomenon, cementing her status as a sex symbol.

Phoebe Cates, known for her roles in iconic 80s films, has taken a step back from acting but remains a beloved figure from that era.

9. Heather Locklear

Birth Year: 1961

Heather Locklear's stunning looks and magnetic on-screen presence made her a household name in the 1980s TV series "Dynasty." With her golden tresses, piercing eyes, and curvaceous figure, she exuded a confident sexuality.

Heather Locklear has faced personal challenges but has also made appearances in TV shows and movies over the past decade.

10. Tanya Roberts

Birth Year: 1955

Tanya Roberts' striking beauty and hourglass figure made her a true bombshell in 1980s films like "A View to a Kill" and "Sheena: Queen of the Jungle." Her ability to command attention with her fierce sexuality and undeniable screen presence was unmatched.

Tanya Roberts continued to act until her passing in 2021, leaving behind a legacy of work in film and television.

11. Elle Macpherson

Birth Year: 1964

With her statuesque frame, piercing eyes, and effortless confidence, Elle Macpherson embodied supermodel chic in the 1980s. Her role in "Sirens" showcased her ability to captivate audiences with her jaw-dropping beauty and undeniable allure.

Elle Macpherson, known as "The Body," has focused on her business ventures and remained active in the fashion industry.

12. Kelly Preston

Birth Year: 1962

Kelly Preston's classic beauty and elegant charm shone through in her 1980s films like "Christine" and "Twins." Her timeless sophistication and ability to exude an alluring presence made her a standout.

Kelly Preston was active in acting until her passing in 2020, leaving behind a legacy of work in film and television, as well as her husband John Travolta and their 2 children.

13. Kim Basinger

Birth Year: 1953

Kim Basinger's striking features and sultry on-screen presence made her a true Hollywood bombshell in the 1980s. Her role in "9 1/2 Weeks" showcased her ability to ooze sensuality and command attention with her smouldering gaze.

Kim Basinger has continued to act and be involved in various projects over the past decade.

14. Cindy Crawford

Birth Year: 1966

With her iconic mole, piercing eyes, and enviable figure, Cindy Crawford became the epitome of supermodel glamour in the late 1980s. Her appearance in 1995's "Fair Game" showcased her undeniable beauty and effortless confidence.

Cindy Crawford, known as one of the original supermodels, has remained active in the fashion industry and in various philanthropic endeavours.

15. Olivia Newton-John

Birth Year: 1948

Olivia Newton-John's radiant beauty and infectious charm made her a beloved actress and singer in the iconic 1978 film "Grease." Her wholesome yet undeniably alluring presence captured the hearts of audiences worldwide. She continued with hits like Xanadu (1980) and a successful music career.

Olivia Newton-John continued to be involved in music and charity work over the past decade until her untimely passing in 2022.

16. Mia Sara

Birth Year: 1967

With her exotic beauty and captivating on-screen presence, Mia Sara became a rising star in the 1980s classic "Ferris Bueller's Day Off." Her smouldering gaze and undeniable allure commanded attention.

Mia Sara has taken on fewer acting roles and opted for a quieter life in recent years.

Demi Moore

Birth Year: 1962

Demi Moore's striking looks and toned physique made her a true bombshell in 1980s films like "St. Elmo's Fire." Her ability to exude a confident sexuality that was both empowering and alluring set her apart.

Still a household name, Demi Moore has continued to act and be involved in various projects over the past decade.

18. Heather Thomas

Birth Year: 1957

With her stunning looks and curvaceous figure, Heather Thomas embodied the quintessential 1980s bombshell in the hit TV series "The Fall Guy." Her undeniable beauty and magnetic screen presence captivated audiences.

Heather Thomas has taken a step back from acting but remains a recognisable figure from the 1980s.

19. Christina Applegate

Birth Year: 1971

Christina Applegate's fresh-faced beauty and natural charm made her a beloved actress in the hit 1980s TV series "Married... with Children." Her relatable yet undeniably alluring presence endeared her to audiences.

Christina Applegate continued to act on TV shows like "Dead to Me" and remained active in the entertainment industry over the past decade, despite being diagnosed with MS. Applegate's openness about her battle with multiple sclerosis has shed light on the complexities of living with this condition and has inspired others facing similar challenges.

20. Vanessa Williams

Birth Year: 1963

As the first African-American woman to be crowned Miss America, Vanessa Williams' stunning looks and poise made her a trailblazer in the 1980s. Her undeniable beauty and magnetic screen presence were showcased in films like "The Pickup Artist."

Vanessa Williams has been involved in various TV series like "9-1-1" and "The L Word: Generation Q" over the past years.

That's all, folks!

The 1980s were a decade that celebrated glamour, beauty, and iconic style. These 20 stunning actresses captivated audiences with their undeniable allure, talent, and magnetic screen presence. From the sultry bombshells to the fresh-faced ingenues, they left an enduring imprint on popular culture, forever etching their names in the annals of Hollywood history. As we look back at these timeless beauties, we are reminded of the enduring power of true star quality and the lasting impact of iconic performances. While time may have passed, their legacies continue to inspire and captivate generations of movie enthusiasts, reminding us of the magic that unfolds when beauty and talent converge on the silver screen.

Let us know who you think we may have missed?
